Commentary.Commentary: After a disciplined bowling performance yesterday, the visitors had a very different outing today. They were wayward in their execution and it looked as if they had no plan whatsoever. Subashis Roy was the pick of the bowlers, he got the ball to reverse and scalped two wicket. Mehedi Hasan was again amongst the wickets as he chipped in with three. Join us in short while for the second innings!

Dinesh Chandimal and Rangana Herath continued from where they left off yesterday and added 55 runs for the 8th wicket. Then another 55-run stand between Suranga Lakmal and Chandimal for 9th wicket frustrated the Bangladeshis even more. After Chandimal's wicket, Bangladesh thought they would get rid of the last wicket quickly. But, it wasn't to be. The frustration started building and the tempers started flaring. Lakmal made full use of it and stitched 33 runs with Sandakan for the last wicket.

A session and innings which belonged to only one man, Dinesh Chandimal! What a knock he played! When everyone else failed, he stood out tall and continued his good form against Bangladesh, scoring his 4th Test ton against them. After being 238/7 at stumps on day 1, the tail partnered Chandimal well to add 100 runs more.

The ball goes off the top edge straight to Sarkar at third man, who is very fine. Good field placement from Rahim once again! We are ready for action. The players and the umpires walk out to the middle. DINESH CHANDIMAL and RANGANA HERATH to continue their innings. SHAKIB AL HASAN to continue his over. Here we go...

Russel Arnold doing the pitch report says a few scars have appeared on the surface. Adds that the bowlers can expect something, especially the spinners. Mentions that the spinners will like to bowl on this track. Feels that it is slightly two-paced but batsmen who apply themselves can do well.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the second Test between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh in Colombo. Dinesh Chandimal led the hosts well with the bat, scoring a gritty 86 to ensure they had an answer to the discipline of the visitors. They have begun their 100th Test well and will hope to wrap up the innings soon and look to bat on what has been a tricky pitch. Stay tuned for all the action.
Day 2... Session 1....

Right then! Neither side would be too disappointed at the score right now. Bangladesh will hope to break this partnership quickly tomorrow morning and keep Sri Lanka under 270 while the Lankans would aim for the tail to wag. Join us tomorrow for all the action. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

A mixed day for the fielding side. Mustafizur Rahman and Subhasis Roy made the most of a terrific opening spell but then the others found it tough to match up with that. The Fizz picked up a wicket in his first and last spell while the others, barring Mosaddek, picked up at least a wicket. Most of the Lankan wickets were gifted but Bangladesh will not mind that.

Dinesh Chandimal has stood tall, with a fine unbeaten 86 and received good support from Dhananjaya de Silva and Niroshan Dickwella who made 34 each. He has now added 43 with skipper Herath which has been frustrating for the Bangladeshis.

Even-stevens day. Bangladesh had a wonderful opening session after being asked to bowl but then the Lankans fought back in the afternoon session. They scored few but then made the most of it in the evening session.
Well, the umpires are not happy with the deteriorating light and that is it for the day. The players look all too happy to walk off. STUMPS ON DAY 1!

On middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.

Landed outside off, Chandimal runs it down to third man. The batsmen take a single, Chandimal returns for the second but is sent back. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and it is referred upstairs but replays show that Chandimal is back safely.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Time for Drinks.
Another slower delivery well outside off, Chandimal squeezes it behind point and gets a single for it.
Rahman comes around the wicket and angles in a fullish delivery towards Dinesh. Driven to the fielder at mid on.
Hurls in an off-cutter on middle at 122 clicks, Chandimal stays leg side of the ball and blocks it out to the off side.
Full delivery outside off, dug out towards covers.
Smart bowling from Mustafizur! He has kept it very tight today. On a length in line of the stumps, Dinesh covers the line and keeps it out.
Full length ball on off, pushed off the front foot down the track.
Shortish delivery around off, turned off the back foot to the on side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sliding down leg, Rangana looks to nudge it but misses.
Low full toss, Herath sweeps it towards mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Loopy ball on off, going straight on. Herath goes for the fancy reverse sweep but seems to have missed it and struck on the pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW and the umpire obliges to rule it out. Herath goes for the review. The replays show that he has gloved it. How did the umpire did not pick it up? The on-field call is overturned straightaway.
Rangana Herath has been given out LBW. He has decided to take the review and looks confident. Has he got bat on that?
Tossed up around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Short delivery going down the leg side, Herath initially thought of pulling it but decides to leave it alone.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
That was not far away from the off pole! On a length outside off, swirling in. Herath opts to point his bat skywards as the ball whizzes past him and through to the keeper.
Short of  a length ball well outside off, shaping in after pitching. Herath looks to cut it but mistimes it to covers.
Full length ball on off, Rangana strides forward and keeps it out.
Full toss on off, Herath eases it down to mid off.
Comes forward and keeps it out with a solid front foot block.
Loopy ball around off, swept towards fine leg for one.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended into the ground.
Flatter through the air, flicked towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Outside off, pushed towards point for one.

NOT OUT! Short delivery in line of the stumps, pulled to Shakib at mid-wicket who fires a direct hit at the bowler's end and succeeds. The umpire refers it upstairs. The replays show that Chandimal was lazy to get back in but just about manages to do it.
A run out appeal against Chandimal is taken upstairs.
What a way to welcome Herath at the crease! Bowls a toe crusher on middle and leg, Herath just about manages to keep it out on the off side and the bat falls down from his hand in the process.
RANGANA HERATH comes out to bat.

OUT! MUSTAFIZUR GETS HIS SECOND WICKET! Very full delivery well outside off, Dilruwan looks to squeeze it through square of the wicket on the off side but ends up getting a healthy outside edge that flies towards first slip. Soumya Sarkar who is stationed there leaps and takes a fine catch. Bangladesh are right on top.
Fullish delivery on off, driven to the fielder at mid off.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Perera strides forward and pushes it down the track calmly.
On a length on off and angling away from Dilruwan. He plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN comes back for another spell.
Short delivery in line of the stumps, Perera pulls it towards the fielder at short leg who takes a blow and the ball deflects to mid-wicket. A single taken!
Perera strides forward to the fullish delivery and defends it down the track.
Short delivery outside off, Chandimal rocks back and punches it to deep cover for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated in line of the stumps, eased through mid on for a single.
Tossed up around off, punched to mid off who is standing a bit deep and the batsmen get a single.
Loopy delivery, Dilruwan prods forward and keeps it out.
Tossed up around off, driven to mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
SIX! Beautiful! Loopy ball on off, Perera dances down the track and lofts it down the ground. Has connected that really well and the ball clears the fence with ease.
Tossed up around off, driven towards mid off for a quick single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Loopy ball around off, driven to the fielder at covers.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Dinesh makes room and drives it to mid off. Takes on the fielder and the throw is to the keeper. Single taken!
The umpires are passing the ball through the 8-shaped gauge. Seems alright to carry on at the moment. Meanwhile, the players are taking a breather.
Tossed up outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Tosses it up nicely outside off, Dilruwan goes for a drive but gets an inside edge down to fine leg. Single taken!
Sliding down leg this time, Perera looks to nudge it but misses.
Short delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot to mid off.
Blocks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Shorter in length, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Around leg stump, spinning away, blocked back to the bowler.
A bit shorter, punched through the covers.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
TAIJUL ISLAM is back on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Sees the batsman come down the track and fires in a yorker at the stumps. Dilruwan jams it to the off side.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
DILRUWAN PERERA walks in at number 8, replacing Dickwella.

OUT! Bowled! A rash stroke brings about the dismissal. Full and well outside leg, Dickwella looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. The ball goes beneath the bat and pegs the leg stump back. One can say it is a needless stroke but then that is the way young kids play these days. End of a flashy innings.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is back on.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and around leg, Dickwella looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Mehedi appeals but this was going down leg.
On middle and leg, worked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. That's an excellent chase by the fielder. Three runs added to the total.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Full and on middle, Chandimal flicks it through mid-wicket ala flamingo style through mid-wicket for a boundary!

Full and outside off, Niroshan drives this through the covers and sets off for a single. Chandimal is caught napping and responds late but makes it in time as the fielder is a bit slow to get to the ball.
Outside off, played straight to point.
FOUR! Strays down the leg side, Dickwella just helps it past the keeper to the fine leg fence. The stand is worth 32 now.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

NO BALL, FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Dickwella gets on top of the bounce and crunches this in front of point for a boundary! Roy overstepped as well with his foot just touching the line. Dickwella moves to 23 with his third boundary.
Outside off, punched through the off side again.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and drives it towards cover.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

CLOSE SHAVE FOR DICKWELLA! Good length delivery slanting across Niroshan. He looks to force it through the off side but gets a bottom edge that flies towards Mushfiqur. He dives to his right, gets his hands to it but fails to hold on to it. The replays show that it just bounced before Rahim. Good over by Roy!

On a length around leg stump, nipping in a shade. Dickwella hops back and looks to keep it out but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud shout for lbw is turned down by the umpire. Replays show that it pitched outside the leg stump.
Similar length delivery on middle and leg, turned towards the leg side. A run taken!
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Gets it in the blockhole just outside off, Dickwella is alert to it and digs it out just in time.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length ball outside off, Niroshan hangs back and punches it through point and the ball rolls through the fence.
Wide! Bangs in a bouncer outside off, Dickwella ducks under it. Wide signalled by the umpire for height.
SUBASHIS ROY comes back for a bowl.
Full delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to short extra cover.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Al Hasan drags his length back, Chandimal camps back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Spinning into Dickwella from outside off. He works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery outside off, Dickwella rocks backs and cuts it behind point for a couple.
Fullish delivery on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
We are back for the third session. DINESH CHANDIMAL and NIROSHAN DICKWELLA to continue their innings. SHAKIB AL HASAN to start off the proceedings after Tea. Here we go...
...DAY 1, SESSION 3...

Mushfiqur Rahim has shuffled his bowlers well and Roy has been impressive. He has generated good reverse swing and has kept the batsmen on their toes. Chandimal has been lucky on occasions but he is holding one end up well. Can he along with Dickwella take Sri Lanka to safe harbours or will Bangladesh trigger a collapse and finish the day on a high? Join us for the final session in a while.

A much better session for Sri Lanka as they have managed to score 79 runs for the loss of a sole wicket in 26.2 overs. Dinesh Chandimal and Dhananjaya de Silva came together after lunch and played sensibly. They stitched together a 66-run partnership before de Silva threw his wicket away. It was a rash shot considering the situation of the match and he paid the price for it.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven through widish mid off for a single. That shall be TEA ON DAY 1!
Full around off, Nirsohan prods forward to block it.
Outside off, spinning away, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Served full on middle and leg, dug out well by Chandimal.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven back to the bowler.
Served outside off, Dickwella guides it through to third man for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, cut to point.
Wide outside off, punched on the up to covers.

NOT OUT! Decision stays as it is! Pitched around leg, sliding down leg, Niroshan gets down on one knee, looking to sweep but misses. Is rapped on the front pad. There's a huge appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. After a long discussion and after being convinced by Mehedi, Rahim goes for the review. The replay confirms that the bat is not involved. The Ball Tracker shows that the impact is umpire's call and the ball is going onto miss the leg stump. That's a waste of a review from Bangladesh! No idea why they went for it when the skipper himself wasn't so sure about it!
Bangladesh take a review against Niroshan Dickwella regarding an LBW decision. Seems like it was sliding down leg.
Tossed up around off, ND covers his stumps and dead bats it.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Dickwella camps back and cuts it through the left of the backward point fielder for a boundary. Good start off the over for SL!
MEHEDI HASAN to roll his arm over now.
Fuller delivery around off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Served outside off, Chandimal prods ahead and defends it towards point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Dickwella gets down the track, drives the full ball past the bowler. Takes off for a quick single and completes it with ease. Good running that!
Tossed up delivery around off, defended from near the surface.
Straighter one outside off, ND looks to run it down to third man but misses it completely.
The ball just slipped out of Taijul's hand!
Short delivery, angling down leg, Chandimal ducks under it again to leave it.
Banged in short, DC ducks under it.
Full delivery around off, driven straight back. Roy fields and mimes to throw it back at the batsman's end. Chandimal gets away from the firing range and returns a smile to Roy!
Fuller length delivery outside off, Dinesh covers his stumps and remains composed in defence.
Full outside off, driven through covers. Tamim Iqbal there, dives to his left and makes a wonderful stop.
Length delivery outside off, gets it shape away after pitching, pushed away from his body to point.
Tossed up slower through the air outside off, DC leans ahead and gently defends it in the gap on the off side. Takes off for a single and completes it!
Full outside off, pushed to short extra cover.
Served fuller outside off, defended off the front foot.
Full outside off, driven slightly uppishly to mid off.
Landed outside off, spinning in sharply, Dickwella goes back and cuts it through covers for a single. Risky shot that!
Served outside off, spinning in, defended well on the off side.
On a length outside off, DC doesn't have a go at it.
Full delivery outside off, Dinesh prods forward and drives to mid off.
Banged in short, angling down leg, pulled through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller length delivery outside off, angling away, driven on the up to the shortish cover-point fielder.
Very full, just outside off, dug out well by Niroshan on the off side.
Full and angling away, Dickwella drives on the up to covers with ease.
SUBASHIS ROY comes back into the attack.
Full delivery on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Full outside off, DC shoulders his arms at it.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended by proding forward.
Full in the line of the stumps, Dickwella sweeps it, the ball ricochets off the man at short leg towards deep square leg. A single taken!
NIROSHAN DICKWELLA comes out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Short and sliding in, de Silva goes back to pull but misses. The ball brushes the back pad and crashes into the stumps. That's really a poor choice of shot from de Silva. He was playing so well and when his team needed him, he goes for a loose shot. End of the 66-run stand! Will the visitors come back again in the game?

Flatter through the air around off, straightening a touch, de Silva comes forward to play but misses and gets hit on the pads. There's a huge appeal for lbw from the players behind the stumps but the umpire says not out.
Angling towards the pads, clipped to square leg.
Comes from over the wicket, angles it across Chandimal, he lets it go through to the keeper.
Angling into the pads, flicked through square leg for a brace.
Outside off, left alone.
12th Test fifty for Dinesh Chandimal.

Angling into the pads, worked to fine leg for a couple. With this, Chandimal gets to his fifty. He has got some reprieves but has made the most of it. So after a dismal tour of South Africa, Chandimal is back in his groove with back-to-back half centuries.
Very full outside off, DC gets low to keep it out.
Served outside off, placed through the gap in point for a single.
Full around off, driven to mid off.
Sliding into the batsman, worked through front of square on the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Full outside off, Chandimal kneels down to sweep. Gets a big top edge and the ball balloons high in the air. Mehedi Hasan at fine leg comes running in and dives forward to catch it and grabs it. The Bangladeshi players are celebrating but the umpires are not sure and want to have a look. The replays aren't conclusive enough and the third umpire goes with the soft signal. Sticks to not out and Chandimal survives again. A single is taken!

Brilliant effort by Mehedi Hasan at fine leg to take a catch of Chandimal. The umpires are checking whether he has taken it cleanly or not but Mehedi Hasan is confident about the grab. The umpires have referred it upstairs and the soft signal is not out!
Sliding in from middle and leg, defended on the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Angling away, left alone.

FOUR! Comes over the wicket, bangs it short, angling towards the batsman, de Silva, who is a good puller of the cricket ball, goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies over towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Full outside off, angling in, DdS leans ahead to defend but gets it off the outer half of the bat towards backward point.
Fullish outside off, another solid defence presented by de Silva.
Slightly fuller outside off, Dhananjaya stays within the crease and defends with a straight bat.
Length delivery, angling in, straightens a touch after pitching, keeps low as well. De Silva who shapes to cut has to adjust but still fails to get any bat on the ball.
Outside off, pushed to covers again.
Full outside off, Chandimal presses forward and pushes to covers.
Two Leg byes! Sliding down leg, DC misses his flick. The ball goes off the thigh pad down the leg side. A couple of leg byes taken!
Shortish delivery, sliding in, punched off the back foot to covers.
Full on middle and off, pushed to the left of the bowler.
Tossed up around off, defended by proding ahead.
TAIJUL ISLAM replaces Mehedi!
Bowls it full and wide outside off, DdS reaches for it and pushes to cover-point.
Rahman will now come from around the wicket!
Angling across from Dhananjaya, defended solidly from within the crease.
Full outside off, de Silva shifts his balance onto the front foot and pushes it to covers.
Full and angling away, blocked from near the surface.
Outside leg, angling towards the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
Full delivery on middle and leg, almost a yorker, dug out back to the bowler.
Change of ends for MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN!
Full around off, DC kneels down and sweeps through backward square leg for a single.
Spinning in from outside off, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
50-run stand between Dinesh Chandimal and Dhananjaya de Silva!
Drags his length back, DdS goes back and punches it through cover-point for a couple.
FOUR! Served fuller outside off, de Silva reverse sweeps it past slip for a boundary. Good innovation!
Tossed up outside off, spinning in, driven to the right of the bowler.
Low full toss, Chandimal kneels down and sweeps to deep square leg for a single.
MEHEDI HASAN to start the proceedings after drinks!
Drinks break!
Loopy ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Dhananjaya sits back again to the quicker one on middle and defends it down the track.
Coming in with the arm in line of the stumps, de Silva camps back and defends it nicely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Chandimal comes down the track and eases it through mid off for a run.
Quicker one on off, pushed off the back foot to covers.
Fullish delivery on off, de Silva covers the line and pushes it down the track.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps and perhaps the slower one, Chandimal is a bit early into his flick shot and as a result gets it uppishly through the vacant mid-wicket region. Single taken!
Full delivery angling across Dinesh. He plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
Full length delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Back of a length deliverty shaping away from Chandimal. He camps back and pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! Shot! Shorter length ball in line of the stumps, de Silva camps back and works it through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Short delivery outside off, punched through covers for a run.
Chandimal uses his feet and drives it through mid off for a couple.
Tossed up delivery outside off, pushed to covers.

NOT OUT! Review successful! Tossed up delivery drifting in with the arm, Dinesh looks to defend it on the leg side but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads and the ball deflects towards Soumya Sarkar at first slip. Shakib goes up in a massive appeal and the umpire rules it out. The Bangladeshi side are ecstatic but Chandimal immediately goes for the review. Time for the replays. The third umpire doesn't find any bat involved in the replays and overrules the on-field call for caught behind. Checks for the LBW now. Hawk Eye shows that it would have missed the leg stump. Dinesh survives!
Chandimal is declared out caught at first slip! He straightaway has gone for the review!
Almost a replica of the previous delivery and de Silva once again remains composed to see it through.
That's well bowled! Good length delivery angling across and de Silva plants his front foot across and leaves it alone.
FOUR! Delightful shot! Full length ball on off, de Silva comes a touch forward and times his drive to perfection down the ground for a gorgeous boundary.
Mustafizur angles across a full length delivery from Dhananjaya. He comes forward and pushes it to short cover.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, de Silva defends it off his back foot to mid-wicket.
On a length in line of the stumps, Chandimal turns it towards short mid-wicket, takes on the fielder running in and completes the single with ease. That brings up 100 for Sri Lanka!
MUSTAFIZUR REHMAN is back for another spell!
Short of a length outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Driven towards the mid on region by Dinesh and a good early call allows the batsmen to come across for a quick single.

Smart piece of bowling from Al Hasan! Tosses it up arouund off, Dinesh dances down the track and looks to slog it, may be over mid off but ends up slicing it over point. Two runs taken! That was a poor shot from the experienced campaigner. As a senior player, you need to play with responsibility. The last thing that Sri Lanka would want is losing another wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Chandimal comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Coming in with the arm towards the leg stump, worked with the angle towards fine leg. Single taken!
Short delivery on middle and leg, pulled through square leg for a run.
Length delivery around off, de Silva turns it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball in line of the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Full length ball on off, Chandimal pushes it crisply to mid off and takes on Shakib. He has to sprint towards the other end and is struggling but the throw from Shakib at the bowler's end bounces above the stumps, which saves him. Replays show that if there was a direct hit, Dinesh was a goner.
Similar length ball around off, Dinesh covers the line and defends it nicely to the off side.
Short of a length delivery around off, shaping in. Chandimal gets behind it and defends it stoutly down the track.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, de Silva comes forward and defends it nicely.
Short delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to short extra cover who stops it easily. That was a poor delivery, Dhananjaya failed to capitalize on that one.
Shakib gets good drift on that and lands it fullish on middle and leg, de Silva keeps it out towards mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for two runs.
Shakib gets slow away turn from around off and de Silva dabs it to point.
On a good length around off this time, Dinesh covers the line and defends it nicely.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller length ball tailing in from around off, Chandimal looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full length ball outside off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
A bouncer outside off, Chandimal is shaping for the upper cut but the ball is too high to play that shot.
Roy bangs in a short delivery on middle and leg, Dhananjaya pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Short delivery outside off, cut away through cover-point for a single.
De Silva comes forward and defends it nicely.

A BIG SHOUT FOR LBW IS TURNED DOWN! Tossed up on middle and off, spinning away a bit. Chandimal looks to sweep it across but misses and the ball goes away towards the off side. There's a loud appeal for lbw but the umpire is not interested and shakes his head. Good call by the umpire as the replays show the ball struck him on the forearm and was also turning away a lot.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Flighted delivery around off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, turning away. De Silva hangs back and punches it towards the fielder at covers who fumbles to concede a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Dinesh strides forward and defends it nicely to covers.
Similar length delivery curving back in from outside off. Chandimal hops back and keeps it out from the inner half of his bat to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball outside off, shaping in a touch. Dinesh camps back and defends it down the track.

Four Leg byes! Roy steams in and bowls a well-directed bouncer on middle, Chandimal takes his eyes off the ball and looks to duck under it but the ball brushes his helmet and goes over the keeper's head and through to the fence. Four leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Fuller length ball outside off, de Silva lunges forward to defend but gets it from the outer half of his bat behind point. A run taken!
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Chandimal drives it beautifully through covers and gets three runs for doing so. Good timing on that!
Tossed up outside off, spinning away. De Silva stays back and defends it solidly.
FOUR! Good intent from Dhananjaya! He uses his feet and takes on the tossed up delivery in line of the stumps. Manages to get it from the inner half of his bat and over mid on for his first boundary.
Stays back to the slow delivery outside off and defends it down the track.
Chandimal comes down the track to the tossed up delivery outside off and eases it to long off. Single taken!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter delivery turning into de Silva. He works it from his back foot and through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery swinging back in appreciably, Chandimal covers the line and pushes it to mid on.
Similar length delivery shaping back into Dinesh sharply. He looks to defend it but the ball hits his thigh pad.

Good length delivery nipping in sharply at 140 clicks, Chandimal is cut into two halves and it seems that the ball has gone through his defences and has brushed something on its way towards Mushfiqur, who is not able to hold onto it. The replays show that the ball had brushed the back pad on its way.
There's again halt in play! This time the halt is due to the car parked beside the sightscreen. The reflections from the cars parked there was creating the problem.
Roy bangs in a bouncer around off, Chandimal sways away from the line of the delivery and evades it.
Full length ball outside off, Dinesh prods forward and times his drive nicely through mid off. Gets a couple of runs for doing so.
Back of a length delivery on off, de Silva turns it through mid-wicket for a run and gets off the mark.
Loopy delivery around off, spinning away. Chandimal covers the line and defends it solidly. A maiden for Shakib.
This time Dinesh prods forward to the flighted delivery and defends it nicely.
Chandimal agains camps back to the shorter delivery outside off and pushes it to covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Slow through the air outside off, Chandimal camps back and defends it to short cover.
Tossed up on off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to continue his spell.
Fullish delivery on off, Dhananjaya strides forward and defends it gently back to Roy.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
We are back for the second session. DINESH CHANDIMAL will continue his innings and DHANANJAYA DE SILVA joins him in the middle. Subashish Roy to continue his over.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Chandimal is out in the middle and has looked comfortable so far while the others have struggled. The track is dry and there is good assistance for the spinners from the beginning. It will be a tough task for the home side to counter the spin trio of Mehedi, Shakib and Taijul who have found their groove. Will the Bangladeshi side keep on taking regular wickets and tumble the Lankans or will the hosts fight back in the  second session? Join us in a while for all the action!

Bangladesh are on top and have begun their 100th Test match in a brilliant manner. Subashis Roy sent Asela Guanratne packing just at the stroke of Lunch and that was an icing on the cake for the visitors. They have bowled tight lines and lengths, especially the spinners and have not let the Sri Lankan batsmen off the hook. Mustafizur was miserly as ever and kept asking questions to the batsmen. He drew first blood and was hard to score of. The young off spinner, Mehedi Hasan was terrific as well and the batsmen found it difficult to tackle him. He took a couple of quick wickets to push the Islanders further on the back foot.

OUT! BOWLING CHANGE WORKS! Excellent captaincy by Rahim. After seeing both these players deal with spin well, he brought on Subashis Roy. Now coming back to the ball, it was a full delivery, angling into the stumps. Gunaratne comes across, looking to flick but misses it completely and is rapped up on the pads. There's a huge appeal and it is ruled out instantly. Gunaratne knew it and was already making his way back. Bangladesh will be full of joy and why won't they be! On this note, it will be LUNCH ON DAY 1!
On a length outside off, Asela prods forward in defence but defends it straight into his toes. He is hurt after that and is taking his time to shake it off!
Length delivery outside off, defended from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery outside off, AG gets on his toes and defends it into the surface.
NO BALL! Length delivery outside off, played to point. No ball signalled for overstepping!
Subashis Roy comes back for a bowl. Probably his last over before lunch.
Sliding into the pads, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Asela dances down the track, Shakib bowls it a touch wide. So, Asela blocks it out on the bounce.
Full delivery, Gunaratne prods forward to keep it out.
Served around leg, spinning away, Gunaratne follows the ball and defends very late after the turn.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and wide outside off, Asela gives himself room and drives it straight to the man at short extra covers. Misses out on that!
Sliding into the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single after a slight hesitation.
Straighter one around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Served outside off, spinning in, AG covers his stumps and defends it solidly.
FOUR! Full outside off, Asela leans ahead and caresses it through point for a boundary.
Spinning in from around off, punched towards mid on and the batsmen scurry through for a run.
Full outside off, Gunaratne extends his arms and drives through covers for three runs.
Served outside off, Dinesh prods forward to keep it out.
Bye! Down the leg side, AG lets it go. Rahim behind the stumps fails to collect it and a bye is taken.
Sliding in, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Confusion in the middle! Full outside off, pushed in the cover region. Mehedi Hasan at short extra cover cuts it to his left. Chandimal is sent back from halfway. A throw at the striker's end is a tame one and Chandimal is safe. Lucky for Sri Lanka, that it didn't prove costly.
Full and straight outside off, Asela pads it away again. There's an appeal for lbw but denied straightaway by umpire Dar.
Outside off, defended on the off side.
Beaten! A touch short outside off, Gunaratne looks to punch it off the back foot through the off side but misses by just.
Served full outside off, Gunaratne with a big stride forward, pads it away.
Straighter one around off, Chandimal looks to play it across the line but gets a leading edge through point for a single.
Leg gully in place now.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Chandimal gets across, kneels down and sweeps it very fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Loopy ball outside off, Asela prods forward in defense.
Fullish delivery outside off, Gunaratne covers the line and defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

AN LBW APPEAL IS TURNED DOWN! Bowls a tossed up delivery and it comes in with the arm. Gunaratne takes a couple of steps down the track and looks to block it out but misses and is hit low on the pad. The umpire is not interested in the loud shout. Bangladesh think about the review but decide against it. The replays show that it might have just gone down leg.
Shakib drags his length back and bowls it outside off, Dinesh camps back and punches it through covers for a run.
Tossed up around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
SHAKIB AL HASAN comes on for a bowl.
Outside off, defended from within the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

SHOUT FOR LBW, TURNED DOWN! Straighter one outside off, Gunaratne covers his stumps, looking to defend. But, he plays for the turn and gets beaten and the ball hits him on the back pad. There's a loud appeal but it is turned down as impact is outside off.
Shortish delivery, punched through covers for a single.
Served outside off, played to point.
Slower through the air outside off, Asela waits for it and then gently defends it in the cover region for a quick single.
Short delivery, sliding in, DC goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Punched through covers off the back foot for a single.
Sliding in from around off, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers.
Short fine leg in place now.

FOUR! Top edged and raced away! Tossed up delivery outside off, Chandimal went for the sweep. Got a top edge and the ball ran away over the keeper's head for a boundary. Sabbir looked to cut it out in the deep but failed to get a hand to the ball.
Sliding into the pads, turned through front of square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full delivery in the line of the stumps, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Sliding in from around middle, worked behind square on the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Straighter one on middle and off, Asela covers his stumps and looks to defend it with a straight bat very late. Gets it off the outer half of the bat on the off side.
Quicker through the air on middle and leg, Chandimal leans ahead and defends it from near the surface.
Slower through the air outside off, spinning away. This time Dinesh stays back and taps it towards point.
Slider around middle, Chandimal uses his feet and looks to flick but gets a leading edge to covers.
Sliding in, Chandimal looks to defend it off the front foot but gets it off the inner half of the bat into the ground on the leg side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gunaratne gets to the pitch of the ball, takes the spin out of equation and drives through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Chandimal gets low and sweeps to fine leg for a couple.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, worked to short mid-wicket.
Quicker through the air, in the line of the stumps, worked off the back foot on the leg side.
Spinning into the pads, Chandimal goes back to flick but the ball goes off the pads to leg slip.
Served fuller around off, DC looks to defend it of the front foot but gets it off the outer half of the bat into the ground.
Straighter one on middle and off, sliding in, defended with the angle on the leg side.
Landed outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, DC looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge into the ground.
Full outside off, driven to mid off, off the front foot.
Pitched outside off, pushed to covers.
Full outside off, eased to mid off.
TAIJUL ISLAM comes into the attack.
Served around off, defended into the ground.
Full outside off, Asela covers his stumps and prods forward to dead bat it.
Served on middle and off, sliding in, defended from within the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
ASELA GUNARATNE strides out to bat.

OUT! MEHEDI STRIKES AGAIN! Served slower through the air outside off, spinning away, Tharanga looks to defend it very late. Prods forward to play but gets an outside edge straight to first slip. Soumya Sarkar, the man there crouches low, going forward to grab it cleanly. Tharanga has to depart. Good piece of bowling from Mehedi, he is mixing it up nicely. SL in trouble now!
On middle, skidding in, blocked by proding forward.
Length delivery outside off, DC gets across and defends it to mid on.
FOUR! Superb shot! Full outside off, angling in, Chandimal drives it beautifully through the gap between short extra cover and mid off for a boundary. Great timing and placement!
Full outside off, left alone.
Pitched outside off on a length, punched on the up to covers.
On a length outside off, shaping away, Chandimal makes a watchful leave.
Banged in short, angling down leg, Chandimal ducks under it.
Fullish outside off, pushed to point off the front foot for a single.
In the line of the stumps, defended from within the crease.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Shortish delivery, sliding away, cut to point.
Full outside off, driven through covers. Shakib at short extra cover misfields and allows the batsmen to run through for a brace.
On middle and off, skidding through, Dinesh looks to play it across the line, expecting the ball to turn. But, gets a leading edge to short third man for a single.
Roy bowls this one in line of the stumps, worked through to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chandimal hops and blocks it into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, punched on the up on the off side.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full and swinging back into middle and leg, tucked very late through backward square leg for a single.
Full and angling away, defended off the front foot to covers.
SUBASHIS ROY comes back into the attack!
Flighted delivery on off, Chandimal lunges forward and defends it back to Mehedi Hasan.
DINESH CHANDIMAL walks in at no. 4, replacing Mendis!

OUT! HASAN STRIKES WITH A BEAUTY! Tosses it up nicely outside off and lures Mendis to reach to the pitch of the delivery. He comes down the track and looks to defend it but gets beaten by the and dip on it. Mushfiqur is onto it in a flash and whips the bails off. The youngster fails to make his mark this time. Bangladesh are upbeat and on top.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has driven it through mid- on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

NOT OUT! Good review, Tharanga! On a length and swinging back in appreciably from around off. Tharanga looks to defend it but misses and is rapped on the front pad. Huge appeal for LBW and the umpire obliges to rule it out. Tharanga isn't convinced with the decision and reviews it instantly. The Hawk Eye shows that it would have gone to miss the leg stump. The on-field call is overturned. He continues to live on.
Upul Tharanga has taken an immeditate review against an LBW decision.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Similar delivery outside off, cut away to the fielder at point this time.
FOUR! Shot! Back of a length ball outside off, Tharanga cuts it nicely and through point for a gorgeous boundary.

Short of a length ball outside off, Tharanga looks to cut it away but the ball whizzes past his outside edge and sails into the gloves of the keeper. That was not far way from the outside edge of the bat.
FOUR! Great shot! Tossed up around off, Mendis kneels and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket and the ball races through to the fence.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Quicker delivery and shorter in length around off, spinning away. Perhaps not there to cut and Tharanga cuts it awkwardly to backward point.
A silly point comes in place now!
Loopy delivery around off, coming in with the arm. Upul looks to defend it off his front foot but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up outside off, defended off the front foot to point.
Quicker one coming in with the arm, Tharanga makes room and looks to defend it but misses and is rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal for LBW but that was always going down leg.
In the channel outside off, left alone. Two runs and a wicket from that over.
Fullish delivery angling across Mendis. He stays inside the line of the delivery and lets it go.
KUSAL MENDIS, the hero of the previous match, walks in!

OUT! MUSTAFIZUR DRAWS FIRST BLOOD! He steams in and hurls in a fuller length delivery well outside off, Karunaratne gets sucked into it. Gets forward and pushes at it hard but ends up getting a thick outside edge to Mehedi Hasan at gully who accepts the catch gleefully. End of a struggling knock from Dimuth Karunaratne.
Fuller length ball outside off, Dimuth comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish delivery tailing into Karunaratne. He flicks it from the inner half through square leg and runs two. First run scored off the bat of Mustafizur's bowling.
SMART BOWLING FROM HASAN! Quicker one outside off, skidding through. Tharanga makes a brave leave. Mehedi Hasan starts off with a maiden.
Well bowled! Drifting in with the arm around off, Upul comes forward and looks to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Turn on that occasion! Tosses it up nicely outside off, spinning away. Tharanga stays back and plays it towards backward point.
Loopy ball around off, Tharanga drives it to mid off.
Drifting in this time Tharanga. He stays leg side of the ball and defends it to covers.
Tossed up outside off, holding its line. Defended off the front foot to the off side.
MEHEDI HASAN comes into the attack as there are two southpaws out there! Is it too early for spin? Or will he strike for the visitors? Meanwhile, the sun is out again over P Sara Oval.
Short of a length ball outside off, Karunaratne plays it with an angled bat to the fielder at point.
Fullish length ball on off, Dimuth covers the line and defends it off the inner half down the track.

Five Wides! That's wayward from Mustafizur Rahman! Bangs it in outside off, shoots off the deck as Dimuth sways away and the leaping Mushfiqur sees it fly well above his head and through to the fence.
Rahman goes wider of the crease and angles in a fullish delivery from outside off, Dimuth lunges forward and pushes it back to him.
Back of a length ball outside off, Karunaratne camps back and defends it to the fielder at point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish delivery around off, Karunaratne prods forward and defends it.
It has gone dark out there. The floodlights might come in play soon!
Length delivery on off, defended off the back foot.
Short of a length ball in line of the stumps, turned to square leg for a run.
Fullish delivery angling across Dimuth. He prods forward and looks to defend it but gets an outside edge that rolls to the fielder at gully who stops it with a dive to his right.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, clipped with soft hands to the leg side.

ANOTHER LOUD APPEAL FOR LBW IS TURNED DOWN! On a length around leg stump, nipping in. Karunaratne looks to tuck it away but misses and is pinged on the pads. The umpire is not interested in the LBW appeal. No review from Bangladesh again. The replays indicate that it pitched outside leg stump.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

This is good bowling from Rahman. Full length delivery shaping in from around off, Upul covers the line and pushes it down the track. Rahman gets a hand to it but the ball rolls down the ground. The batsmen think about the single but decide against it.

THAT'S A PEACH! That missed the off pole by a whisker! Fuller length ball outside off, swinging in a touch and holding its line. Tharanga is off balanced and looks to keep it out but it is too good for him and beats him to just miss the off stump.
Mustafizur goes wider of the crease and angles in a back of a length delivery from outside off, Tharanga camps back and pushes it nicely to point.
Hurls this one way outside the off stump and gets to swing in sharply from there. Still it is far away from Tharanga as he makes an easy leave.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, Upul covers the line and defends it down.
Full length ball and attacking the stumps, Tharanga defends it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
A bit of an issue with the sightscreen.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Fullish delivery outside off, Karunaratne strides forward and pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge that runs through between second and third slip and reaches the third man fence.
BEAUTIFULLY BOWLED! Roy gets it to seam across Karunaratne from leg stump. He is forward and has no option but to play at it. The ball whizzes past the outside edge of his bat.

Fullish delivery outside leg stump, angling in a touch. Karunaratne looks to clip it through but is rapped on the pads. Bangladesh appeal again but Roy pulls out after the initial burst. Replays confirm that it pitched outside leg.
Fuller length ball attacking the stumps, clipped to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, defended off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery on middle, zipping through the deck. Tharanga is surprised and looks to fend it off. Ends up gloving it towards square leg and Sri Lanka are off the mark.

A LOUD SHOUT FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Fuller length ball outside off, swinging in appreciably. Karunaratne looks to play it across but misses and is rapped low on the front pad. The Bangladeshi side appeals in unison but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that it would have missed the leg stump. Good call to not take the review.
Fuller and swinging down leg, Dimuth looks to clip it away but misses.
Fuller this time and shaping in line of the stumps, Karunaratne strides forward and defends it.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne covers the line and defends it solidly towards mid off.
On a length tailing back into Karunaratne. He looks to defend it to the on side but is struck on the thigh pad.
THAT'S A JAFFA! Bowls it on a good length outside off, gets it to straighten after pitching. Dimuth comes forward and pushes at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, Tharanga camps back and defends it to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery around off, nipping away. Tharanga is watchful again as he lets it go.
Fullish delivery on off, defended solidly off the front foot down the track.
Good length ball shaping away from Tharanga. He doesn't fiddle with that one.
THAT'S A PEACH! Bowls it on a good length on leg stump and gets it to seam across Upul. He feels for it and gets beaten all ends up.
Length delivery angling across Tharanga. He stays rooted to his crease and leaves it alone.
SUBASHIS ROY to share the new ball!
Fullish delivery outside off, a bit of away swing on that. Karunaratne lunges forward and defends it nicely to the off side. A steady start to the game and Mustafizur earns a maiden for himself.
Fuller length ball outiside off, Karunaratne camps back and defends it towards cover-point.
Fullish and in line of the stumps on this occasion at 127 clicks, Dimuth clips it nicely to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball outside off, Karunaratne plays it with an angled blade to the man at point.
Good length delivery outside off, holds its line and not much bounce on that. Dimuth watches it closely and lets it go.
Starts off with a fullish delivery outside off, Karunaratne strides forward and defends it down the track.

The players are out in the middle. DIMUTH KARUNARATNE and UPUL THARANGA to open the batting for the home side. MUSTAFIZUR REHMAN to start off the proceedings with the ball. He has three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Bangladesh captain, MUSHFIQUR RAHIM says the track looks pretty dry and they would have liked to bat first as well. Adds that Liton Das has fractured his ribs so he has to take the gloves. Mentions that the 100th Test is a great opportunity for them. Feels that what they have done in the past is not good enough and adds that hopefully they will improve. Informs that there are four changes to their side. IMRUL KAYES, SABBIR RAHMAN, MOSADDEK HOSSAIN and TAIJUL ISLAM get a game. Mominul Haque, Mahmudullah and Taskin Ahmed miss out while Liton Das is out with an injury. MOSADDEK will be making his Test debut!

Sri Lanka captain, RANGANA HERATH says that the pitch looks pretty similar to Galle but seems drier. It will be good for batting. Mentions that there is one team change as DHANANJAYA DE SILVA comes in place of Lahiru Kumara.
Toss - SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold doing the pitch report says that P Sara Oval is the most result-oriented ground in Sri Lanka. Adds that it gives everyone a chance, the seamers as well as the spinners. On today's pitch he says it looks to be more dry than usual even though there has been rain in the past few days. Ends up by saying bat first after winning the toss as the pitch will wear and tear as the match progresses.

The visitors on the other hand lost their fourth Test in succession, once again showing how big the gap is between them and the other Test playing nations. However, it's their 100th Test, a landmark which they would like to celebrate with a win. Injury to Liton Das means Mushfiqur Rahim will be donning the gloves. The weather doesn't seem too promising as rain is predicted over the course of five days in the evening session.

Hello and a warm welcome to the opening day of the second and final Test between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh in Colombo. The hosts ruled the roost in the first match and won it comfortably. Rangana Herath and Kusal Mendis were once again very instrumental in their team's victory. The rest of the team supported them well making it their 6th consecutive victory at home. They would look to carry on this winning momentum to cleansweep the series.
